name: demo-001
title: Warm-up: read the file
query: The flag is stored in plain sight inside data.txt. Read the file and report the flag.

name: demo-002
title: Search the access log
query: An access log leaked from a web server. One request line carries a flag in its query string. Search the log and report that flag.

name: demo-003
title: Credential left in a config file
query: A configuration file was committed to a public repository by mistake. One credential value is a flag. Inspect config.ini and report it.
